reference_sql:
SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur,
  ROUND(AVG(budget_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING), 2) AS avg_budget_next_3m,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS months_in_window
FROM budget_monthly
WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
alternatives:
WITH b AS (
  -- one row per paid channel and month of 2025
  SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur
  FROM budget_monthly
  WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
)
SELECT m.channel_id, m.month, m.budget_eur, ROUND(AVG(n.budget_eur), 2) AS avg_budget_next_3m, COUNT(*) AS months_in_window
FROM b m
JOIN b n ON n.channel_id = m.channel_id AND n.month BETWEEN m.month AND m.month + INTERVAL 2 MONTH
GROUP BY m.channel_id, m.month, m.budget_eur

WITH w AS (
  -- one row per paid channel and month of 2025
  SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur,
    AVG(budget_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_next,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS n
  FROM budget_monthly
  WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
)
SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur, ROUND(avg_next, 2) AS avg_budget_next_3m, n AS months_in_window
FROM w

other_way.tradeoff: Joining each month to the 2 months after it gives the same averages because every month has a budget row, but it needs a self-join.
